subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: Should a security-area owner approve this grouped privileged-action update after the stale guard assertions are fixed and exact-head workflow checks pass?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but the PR updates actions that handle tokens, secrets, security scanning, publishing, and agent execution, and the repository protects this surface for explicit owner handling.

options.title: Approve after guard synchronization
options.body: Review the verified upstream deltas after all four exact-token assertions are fixed and the final rebased SHA passes focused workflow checks.

options.title: Recreate as smaller batches
options.body: Split or recreate the grouped update if reviewing twelve privileged action upgrades as one unit is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard synchronization
recommendation.body: Review the verified upstream deltas after all four exact-token assertions are fixed and the final rebased SHA passes focused workflow checks.
